newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Macquarie Bank shares bounce back.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Macquarie Bank shares bounce back.

text.p: The share price of Macquarie Bank Ltd regained Monday's losses in Tuesday afternoon trade with the bank's shares rising more than four percent.
Macquarie shares tumbled on Monday after the bank announced one of its executive directors had been charged under the Financial Transactions Reports Act.
At 2.35 p.m. (0335 GMT), Macquarie shares were 36 cents or 4.27 percent higher at A$8.80 with just over 181,000 shares traded.
On Monday Macquarie shares closed 31 cents lower at A$8.44.
